producer_report.summary:
I changed the idle-producer check in run.rs so a seeded retry whose producer adds nothing now goes on with the seeded candidate. Before, it failed as "the producer made no change". The condition is now `if changes.is_empty()`, and the change list is against the base. A seeded work tree that is unchanged since the seed therefore keeps the seeded candidate and goes on to admission, checks and the verifier. A run from the base with no change still fails as before. The retry test file passes (14 tests), and fmt and clippy are clean. I did not run the full suite; Athena runs it.

In crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs I rewrote the old test, `a_seeded_retry_that_changes_nothing_fails_as_an_empty_candidate`, as `a_seeded_retry_that_changes_nothing_goes_on_with_the_seeded_candidate`. It now checks that the verifier runs, the job lands, the checks pass and the seeded files land. I also added `an_unseeded_run_whose_producer_changes_nothing_still_fails`. CHANGELOG.md has a new Fixed entry, and docs/decisions.md has a new D139 that supersedes D117 item 5.

The run.rs file has no fake-producer test module, so both tests are in retry.rs, not run.rs, and `cargo test -p athena-core` does not run them."

checks_run.note: 14 passed, including the two new tests

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in run.rs seeds a retry from a kept candidate with a fake producer that makes no change; the run reaches checks and the verifier and lands. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: run.rs has no test module with a fake producer; the seeded-retry tests live in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs, so the test is there. a_seeded_retry_that_changes_nothing_goes_on_with_the_seeded_candidate (the old failing test, rewritten) has the retry's fake producer make no edit. It asserts the verifier ran, state is Landed, greeting.txt and README.md landed with the seeded content, and the checks ran and passed. It passes under `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test retry`. I did not run `cargo test -p athena-core`, because the test is in the athena-cli crate.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test shows an unseeded run whose fake producer makes no change still fails with the outcome 'the producer made no change'. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: an_unseeded_run_whose_producer_changes_nothing_still_fails in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs asserts state Failed, reason contains 'the producer made no change', no verifier call, and nothing landed. It passes under `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test retry`. It is in the athena-cli crate, not athena-core.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt and clippy (both clean) and the retry test file (14 pass), not the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing that a seeded retry whose producer adds nothing now goes on with the seeded candidate.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first bullet under [Unreleased] / Fixed in CHANGELOG.md says it, gives the root cause and names the two tests.

criteria_check.criterion: The condition near run.rs line 1761 fails only when there is no change against the base; the comment explains the seeded case.
criteria_check.evidence: run.rs now reads `if changes.is_empty() {`. The comment above it explains that the change list is against the base and that a seeded candidate whose producer adds nothing is kept and goes on to admission, checks and the verifier.

open_issues: The two tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs, not in run.rs, and `cargo test -p athena-core` does not run them. Use `cargo test -p athena-cli --test retry`, or the full suite.

crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs doc comments (around lines 38 and 114) may still say an idle seeded producer is detected with unchanged_since_seed. I did not touch them because the brief puts them out of scope.
The seeded-equals-base case (a seed with an empty change list) has no new test. It is covered only by the change.is_empty() branch, which the unseeded test exercises.
learnings: run.rs has no test module with a fake producer; seeded-retry tests live in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs, using two_phases, first_attempt and second_attempt.

Snapshot::unchanged_since_seed is now unused by the run but is pub in athena-git, so it causes no warning and was left as the brief says. Its doc comments in snapshot.rs still describe the old idle-producer use.
